summary: Defines the ChaCha20 stream cipher and the Poly1305 authenticator, both separately and combined as an authenticated encryption (AEAD) algorithm. It introduces no new cryptography and serves as a stable reference for implementers. It was replaced by RFC 8439.

eli5.summary: A secret-scrambling recipe plus a tamper seal. The scrambler hides your message and the seal shows if anyone changed it along the way.
